text:
Amelia: Quick sync — we need a short plan for paid around the webinar next Tues. Search scale + retarget refresh + inbound routing. Proposal: +15% on high-intent search KW, swap retarget creative on day 3, and route webinar signups straight to MQL queue with utm parsing. Any blockers?
Diego: sounds good. can we limit scale window to 9am-6pm PST to control CPA?
Amelia: yes — dayparting makes sense. keep weekends flat.
Sam: creative note — for retarget swap: we should test 2 variants: "Social proof" (customer quote) vs "Product vignette" (30s gif). run 50/50.
Jordan: routing — confirm fields we need from form: email, company, job_title, utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_content. add hidden field for "webinar_variant" to track creative.
Marie: ops can accept MQL queue via webhook. what's the lead score threshold?
Amelia: lead_score >= 40 to go to MQL. <40 to nurture list. Marie can you add fallback to SDR if lead_score >= 60?
Marie: yep, webhook will handle that. will add fallback logic.
Diego: can we set a hard daily cap per adset to avoid runaway spend? suggest $600/day per adset until we hit VOE.
Sam: creative rotation schedule: swap at 48h for the retarget pool, but for search creatives use headline A/B every 24h.
Jordan: FYI — GA tags: use utm_campaign=webinar_mar_2026, utm_medium=paid_search OR paid_social, utm_source=google,fb. example: /lp?utm_campaign=webinar_mar_2026&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_source=google
Amelia: perfect. Ads team — can you confirm ad copy changes? I'll draft the two CTAs.
Diego: pulling numbers now. rough check: current CPA for webinar form = $42. If we scale +15% hour/day, expect CPA drift ~ +8-12% short term. monitor closely.
ads-bot: [automation] scheduled campaign ramp job created: "webinar-mar26-ramp" starting 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC, initial scale +15%, daypart enforced.
Sam: reminder — update creative asset naming to include variant and date e.g., webinar_vignette_0324_v1.gif
Jordan: for tracking — add a custom event "webinar_signup_variant" to capture which creative drove the click. instrument in the form handler.
Marie: ops notes: webhook URL -> https://ops.redwood.com/webhooks/mql-ingest, auth via HMAC header. I'll send keys in #secure-keys.
Amelia: next steps: Diego finalize budget caps by EOD; Sam upload both creatives by 10am PST tomorrow; Jordan add form tracking today; Marie configure webhook and fallback. We'll reconvene at 11am PST tomorrow if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Diego: on it.
Sam: uploading now.
Jordan: tracking live.
Marie: webhook tested, 200 OK.
Amelia: awesome — thanks team. I'll post the launch checklist in #marketing-ops after this thread. :rocket:
